verdict.rationale: Decagon ships Duet, a built-in assistant that users can hand work to: it generates Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) from past conversations, generates test suites, and iterates on the agent automatically. Ask AI separately takes conversational analysis questions about customer conversations. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how users interact with and direct Duet (interface, scope and limits of delegable tasks), and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Use Duet to easily generate tests covering diverse pathways that verify whether agents respond accurately, follow policies, and reflect your brand.
Duet automatically iterates on your agent, from the first launch through every improvement after.
Analyze past customer interactions to automatically generate Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs) rooted in actual customer needs.
Ask AI powers deeper analysis through flexible, conversational queries.
